title: Stable and Calibrated Latent Force ODE Filters
abstract: arXiv:2610.33939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating unobserved forces in mechanistic systems is a central task of scientific machine learning. Approximate Gaussian filtering methods that synthesize mechanistic and empirical information have shown remarkable capacity in jointly identifying latent processes together with the system state in a single forward-backward pass. The resulting latent force ODE filter framework channels information from observational data specifically into the unknown parts of the system. This work addresses open questions about calibration and stability of the method. We show that the joint posterior over state and force is the reweighted conventional latent force posterior. This uncovers a crucial dependence of the stability of the method on the prior variance of the system state, which effectively controls the flow of information from observations to the latent force through the mechanistic system. From this insight, we construct an improved algorithm

translated_title: 稳定且校准的潜在力常微分方程滤波器
translated_abstract: 在机理系统中估计未观测到的力是科学机器学习的核心任务。综合机理信息与经验信息的近似高斯滤波方法，已在单次前向-后向传递中联合识别潜在过程与系统状态方面展现出卓越的能力。由此产生的潜在力常微分方程（ODE）滤波器框架能够将来自观测数据的信息专门引导至系统的未知部分。本工作解决了该方法在校准与稳定性方面的开放性问题。我们证明了状态与力的联合后验是重新加权的传统潜在力后验。这一发现揭示了该方法的稳定性对系统状态先验方差的关键依赖性，而该先验方差实际上控制着信息从观测数据经由机理系统流向潜在力的过程。基于这一洞察，我们构建了一种改进的算法
tldr: 本文证明了状态与力的联合后验是重新加权的传统潜在力后验，揭示了潜在力ODE滤波器的稳定性关键取决于系统状态的先验方差（它控制着信息从观测数据流向潜在力），并据此构建了改进的校准算法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the joint state-force posterior is a reweighted conventional latent force posterior, revealing that the stability of latent force ODE filters critically depends on the prior variance of the system state—which controls information flow from observations to latent forces—leading to an improved calibrated algorithm.
